## Commentary (part 3)
Nine new categories in `CommentaryLibrary.kt`, each a pair of lines in the two commentary voices (Arnold excited, Antoni calm), 24 pairs in all: `TEST_SESSION_END` (lunch, tea), `TEST_DAY_END` (stumps), `TEST_SESSION_START`, `TEST_DAY_START`, `TEST_NEW_BALL`, `TEST_DECLARATION`, `TEST_INNINGS_END` (all out), `TEST_FOLLOW_ON`, `TEST_DRAW`. They follow the commentary setting (off, duo, one voice) like the rest. The commentary plays first and the spoken score and wickets follow when it has finished, so the two never run over each other (`MatchAudioDirector.speakWhenQuiet`). In a Test the generic innings-break lines ("what a total to chase") are not used. The clips are generated by the web app's commentary endpoint, then "Fetch audio into the app" packs them.
